description: Defines an abstract class CardStreamAnimator for creating various card animation effects in an Android application, including methods for initial, disappearing, appearing, swipe-in, and swipe-out animations, along with an inner class for disabling animations.

classes.name: CardStreamAnimator
classes.description: An abstract class for defining card view animations in an Android layout.

classes.name: CardStreamAnimator.EmptyAnimator
classes.description: A subclass that disables all animations by returning null for all animator methods.

methods.name: setSpeedFactor
methods.description: Sets the speed factor for animations; higher values mean slower animations.

methods.name: getInitalAnimator
methods.description: Abstract method to define the initial animation when a user rotates the screen.

methods.name: getDisappearingAnimator
methods.description: Abstract method to define the animation when a view is removed programmatically.

methods.name: getAppearingAnimator
methods.description: Abstract method to define the animation when a view is added programmatically.

methods.name: getSwipeInAnimator
methods.description: Abstract method for swipe-in (return to origin) animation when a view is not moved enough to be removed.

methods.name: getSwipeOutAnimator
methods.description: Abstract method for swipe-out animation when a view is removed by user swipe.
